image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront featuring a large glass display case in the foreground filled with trays of pastries and cakes. Behind the counter, two individuals (likely staff) are visible. The facade includes a large window with reversed neon signage reading 'ESCAADA' (mirrored text) and a smaller sign to the right. The scene is illuminated by daylight and interior lighting.
